name: TrustLLM
description: TrustLLM is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the trustworthiness of large language models across multiple dimensions including truthfulness, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and machine ethics. It encompasses over 30 datasets and evaluates 16 mainstream LLMs to analyze their trustworthiness and utility.
typical_sota_score: 60–90% (varies widely by trust dimension and dataset)
reputation: A well-known recent benchmark for LLM trustworthiness that is increasingly cited for broad evaluation across safety, fairness, robustness, privacy, and ethics.
notes: Benchmark covers six dimensions of trustworthiness and includes over 30 datasets; evaluates 16 mainstream LLMs.
